trs 0.10.3

check for updates:  trs upgrade --check
upgrade now:        trs upgrade

Install hooks for AI coding tools (claude, gemini, cursor, codex, opencode, kilo, antigravity, agy, droid, devin, pi, vscode, openclaw, hermes, trae, vibe, zed, devin-cli)

Usage: trs init [OPTIONS] [TOOL]

Arguments:
  [TOOL]  Tool to configure (claude, gemini, cursor, codex, opencode, kilo, antigravity, agy, droid, devin, pi, vscode, openclaw, hermes, trae, vibe, zed, devin-cli)

Options:
  -g, --global   Install globally (user-level) instead of project-level
      --show     Show current installation status
      --all      Install hooks for all detected tools
      --replace  Remove competing compressor hooks (rtk, token-optimizer) before installing trs. Required when a collision is detected
      --force    Install trs even if a competing compressor is already configured. Risk: double-compression can corrupt command output
      --dry-run  Preview the install without writing anything. Lists every file that would change and the action taken (create / merge / skip)
      --agent    Output in agent-optimized format (structured for AI consumption)
      --compact  Output in compact format (default for most commands)
      --csv      Output in CSV format
  -h, --help     Print help
      --json     Output in JSON format
      --raw      Output raw, unprocessed input
      --stats    Show execution statistics (input/output size, token reduction)
      --tsv      Output in TSV format
  -V, --version  Print version
